work.description: CCXCV Expositum Nobis fuit: whole three-clause Montolmo emphyteusis brief to Fermo, full dowry-foundation/Carità estate petition,144scudi58oboli valuation and30scudi canon, all male-line duration, security, taxes, boundaries/plan, improvements and reversion conditions, full derogation and datum LF58703–58706. Exact XML leaves442–443 normal substantive order; boundary plan is prescribed for the future conveyance, not a missing current-act annex. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
